text:
Looks like sliced smoked sausage (kielbasa or andouille), about 14 pieces, plus a small green bit (maybe a pepper piece). The plate is about 9 inches (23 cm) across. Each slice is about 2.5 cm across and 1 cm thick, so roughly 5-6 g each. 14 slices come to about 80 g. Smoked sausage runs about 300 kcal per 100 g, so that is roughly 240 kcal.
